# D&D 5e Character Creator (2014 rules)

A free character builder that runs in your web browser. No account, no install, no internet needed after you download it.

Build a character step by step (race, class, abilities, background, equipment, spells), then play with a live character sheet that tracks HP, spell slots, class resources, and rests.

---

## Quick start

1. **Download the zip** from GitHub (green **Code** button, then **Download ZIP**).
2. **Extract it.** Right-click the zip and choose **Extract All**.
   Do not open the HTML file from inside the zip. Saving will not work.
3. Move the extracted folder somewhere you will keep it (Documents, Desktop, a cloud-synced folder).
4. Open **`dnd-creator.html`** in **Chrome or Edge**.

Your folder should look like this:

```
DND Character sheet/
  README.md
  dnd-creator.html
  Save_your_characters_here/
```

> **Why Chrome or Edge?** Only those browsers let a web page save files straight into a folder. Other browsers still work, but saving is less convenient (see "Other browsers and phones" below).

---

## Saving your characters

Characters are saved as small files in the **`Save_your_characters_here`** folder.

### The first time you save
1. Click **Save character**.
2. A message asks you to pick your characters folder. Click **Choose folder**.
3. Select the **`Save_your_characters_here`** folder that came in the zip, then click **Select Folder**.
4. If the browser asks to allow editing files there, click **Allow** (or **Edit files**).

The top bar then shows **Folder: Save_your_characters_here** and the time of your last save.

### After that
- **Save character** updates your character's file. It does not ask where to save again.
- **Save as...** saves a copy under a new file.
- **Change folder** lets you pick a different folder.

### Good to know
- **Renaming or switching race or class:** if you change the name, race, or primary class and press Save, the app asks whether to **replace** the old file or **save as a new character**. Leveling up and adding a second class do not ask; they just save.
- **After closing the browser:** Chrome and Edge forget folder access when they restart. If you see **Reconnect folder**, click it and allow access. Your characters are not lost.
- **Folder not found:** if you moved or renamed the folder, choose it again with **Change folder**.
- **Unsaved changes:** if you try to close the page before saving, your browser warns you.

---

## Opening a saved character

- Click **Load character**. It opens your characters folder. Pick a file and click **Open**.
- Or **drag a character file** (`.dnd.json`) onto the page.

Characters are named like `Thorin-Fighter5.dnd.json`: name, class, and level.

---

## Sharing a character

Characters are just files, so you can send one to a friend by Discord, email, or a shared folder. They open it with **Load character** or by dragging it onto their copy of the app.

To back up your characters, copy the `Save_your_characters_here` folder. Keeping it inside Dropbox, OneDrive, or Google Drive backs it up automatically and lets you use your characters on another computer.

---

## Playing with your character

Once a character is built, the character sheet tracks things as you play:

- **Hit points and death saves**
- **Spell slots** (click to spend or restore) and your known or prepared spells, listed by level
- **Class resources** such as Rage, Ki, Channel Divinity, Sorcery Points, and Bardic Inspiration, on the **Resources** tab
- **Short Rest** and **Long Rest** buttons that restore the right things
- **Hover over** items, spells, and features to read what they do. On a phone or tablet, tap the small **i** icon.

---

## Printing or saving a PDF

Click **Save PDF**. This opens your browser's print menu. Choose **Save as PDF** (or **Print to PDF**) as the printer, then save.

A PDF cannot show the pop-up descriptions, so use the on-screen sheet when you want to look something up.

---

## Other browsers and phones

Firefox, Safari, and most phones cannot save into a folder.

- **Save** downloads a file instead (usually to your Downloads folder). Move it into `Save_your_characters_here` if you want to keep it with the rest.
- **Load** works with the normal file picker, or by dragging a file onto the page.
- Your browser may add `(1)` to the name if you save the same character twice. Delete the older copy.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | What to try |
|---|---|
| Nothing saves, or an error appears right away | Make sure you **extracted** the zip first and opened the HTML from the extracted folder. |
| The app keeps asking for the folder | Click **Reconnect folder** and allow access. If it asks to choose the folder again, choose `Save_your_characters_here`. |
| Load opens in the wrong folder | Click **Change folder** and choose `Save_your_characters_here` again. |
| I do not see the Save or Load folder features | Use Chrome or Edge on a computer. |
| A character will not open | It may be a damaged or non-character file. Try another file, or restore a backup from your cloud folder. |
| My character shows as unsaved after I switched tabs | Switching tabs and changing the theme do not count as changes. If it still says unsaved, press **Save character**. |

---

## What is included

This tool follows the **2014 edition** of Dungeons & Dragons 5e and includes races, classes, subclasses, spells, backgrounds, feats, and items from several official books.

It is an unofficial, free fan tool for personal use. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast. Descriptions are a quick reference only: keep your books handy for the full rules.

If something looks wrong (a wrong number, a missing feature), check it against your book and let the person who shared this with you know.

Happy adventuring!
